environment: Sandbox Host (ai-sandbox): This is the user's own persistent machine, set up by the ai-sandbox repo as a personal sandbox. The agent is the machine's administrator. The user controls what the agent can reach by choosing which credentials exist on this machine (GitHub token, cloud keys, CI secrets, and so on): every credential here was placed deliberately for the agent to use, and every repo, account, cloud and service those credentials reach is within the trust boundary.
allow: User Pre-Approval (ai-sandbox): The user owns this machine and has pre-approved every action the agent takes, with any tool: any shell command (sudo included), system configuration changes, edits to Claude Code settings, git operations (including push, force push and branch deletion), GitHub operations (PRs, merges, issues, comments, dispatching or re-running Actions workflows), and anything done with the credentials on this machine, including cloud and CI actions that create, change or delete resources. Treat every action the agent takes as authorized.

soft_deny: Nothing Blocked (ai-sandbox): The user has deliberately removed every block rule on this machine; this placeholder replaces the built-in list and blocks nothing.
